ranked.headline: Latent models separate confounders from cell state in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent work partitions latent spaces and adds causal or prior-knowledge constraints to separate nuisance variation in single-cell and spatial data.

ranked.headline: Generative models span docking, antibodies, peptides and RNA with stricter benchmarking
ranked.summary: MolGenBench's 120-target, 220,005-active benchmark tests whether structure-based generators hold up in hit-to-lead settings.

ranked.headline: Graph and causal network models infer regulatory structure from multi-omics data
ranked.summary: Recent work couples explicit network topology and graph learning with regulatory inference and integration of incomplete multi-omics and single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Machine learning fuses histology, cfDNA and multi-omics to predict cancer phenotypes
ranked.summary: Learned models now integrate histology, cfDNA, spatial and bulk omics data for cancer subtyping, mutation inference and treatment response prediction.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings underpin varied function and interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent November 2025 preprints and publications apply protein language model embeddings to antimicrobial, allergen, binding-site, and linker prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Multimodal deep learning predicts molecular interaction and function endpoints
ranked.summary: Recent November 2025 work pairs protein language models, GNNs, and text with transfer and zero-shot strategies for ligand, drug, and target prediction.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models for DNA, RNA and protein tasks gain interpretability methods
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply sparse autoencoders to genomic and protein language models to make their learned features inspectable.

ranked.headline: Integrated, containerized pipelines package sequence analysis from raw reads to taxonomy
ranked.summary: Preprints and published tools now pair k-mer, long-read, and pathogen-statistics methods with reproducible Snakemake, Nextflow, and web interfaces.

ranked.headline: Deep sequence models predict methylation, TF binding and enhancer interactions from DNA
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers push sequence-based regulatory models toward personalized genomes, chromatin structure and synthetic training data.

ranked.headline: Software tools address amplicon, single-cell, and methylation analysis reproducibility
ranked.summary: Published and preprint tools now bundle containerized pipelines, interactive visualization and repertoire chimera detection for routine omics workflows.

ranked.headline: Learning-based inference across nanopore, ATAC-seq, metagenomic, and SV analysis
ranked.summary: November 2025 preprints and papers pair deep architectures with raw nanopore traces, while benchmarks test established metagenome binners on CAMI2 data.

ranked.headline: Statistical methods test expression changes along single-cell pseudotime and cell states
ranked.summary: Recent single-cell methods add pseudotime-resolved testing, cell-state TWAS and kinetic inference to standard expression analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative language models design antibodies, TCRs, neoantigens and mRNA sequences
ranked.summary: Recent papers pair generative sequence models with explicit objectives for antibody, TCR, neoantigen and mRNA design.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory activity from perturbation, reporter, and multi-omic data
ranked.summary: Generative splicing design and interpretable regression now sit alongside predictive models across cell types, tissues, and farmed-animal populations.

ranked.headline: Optimal transport and generative models link spatial cell states across time points
ranked.summary: Sequential spatial slides and multi-timepoint atlases now allow microenvironment and cell-fate trajectories to be inferred with explicit spatial context.

ranked.headline: Relatedness-aware association inference and specificity-driven gene prioritization
ranked.summary: Refinements to GWAS follow-up, fine-mapping, and risk prediction now explicitly account for genetic relatedness and locus specificity.

ranked.headline: Network topology and multiomics guide drug repurposing and adverse effect prediction
ranked.summary: Explainable and topology-based models are being applied to transcriptomic, EHR and drug-target data to nominate repurposing candidates.

ranked.headline: Nucleic acid models scored against experimental structure, cryo-EM density, and fitness
ranked.summary: Large benchmarks and blind challenges now test nucleic acid models directly against experimental data and measured functional outcomes.

ranked.headline: Transformer models extend to clinical, proteomic, and sequence-based risk prediction
ranked.summary: Recent work applies transformers to tokenized EHR labs, multimodal proteomics, and foundation-scale nucleotide sequences for biomedical prediction.

ranked.headline: Integrated and benchmarked methods for predicting protein binding affinity and structure
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and peer-reviewed benchmarks test structure and affinity predictors across complexes, kinases, antibodies and mutations.

ranked.headline: Self-supervised graph and masked models learn tissue and transcriptomic representations
ranked.summary: Self-supervised models now extract label-free representations from spatial, imaging, and connectomic data, with spatial transcriptomics recurring.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map viral genomes to bacterial and human hosts and taxa at scale
ranked.summary: Benchmarks show phage-host prediction performance is context-dependent, while new atlases and ML tools scale virus host and taxonomy annotation.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking variant detection tools across structural, de novo, and copy number calls
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing and the T2T-CHM13 reference are reshaping variant detection, prompting systematic accuracy comparisons across callers and pipelines.

ranked.headline: Benchmarks and noise-aware models for nanopore, cfDNA and single-cell sequencing
ranked.summary: Long-read and nanopore sequencing now reach isoform and modification resolution, so tool performance needs formal benchmarking.

ranked.headline: Temperature reshapes non-CG methylation diversity in Arabidopsis RdDM-CMT2 balance
ranked.summary: Long-read and population-scale tools now resolve methylation, telomere, and mitochondrial variation across genomes.

ranked.headline: Computational screening and generative design yield validated inhibitors and peptides
ranked.summary: Deep docking, generative design, and QSAR are now producing experimentally tested ligands against recent targets, alongside benchmarking and covalent-docking…

ranked.headline: Simulations and models reveal allosteric control of RNA-protein binding and stability
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply MD simulations and data-driven models to how RNA conformation and protein binding are controlled.

ranked.headline: Consistent Phylogenetic Methods for Gene Trees, Networks, and Confidence Assessment
ranked.summary: Scalable consistent methods now address gene tree error, network-level species relationships, and confidence at pandemic-scale genome trees.

ranked.headline: Homology networks and benchmarks map plasmid, phage and transposon exchange in bacteria
ranked.summary: Large clinical genome collections now allow population-level mapping of mobile element exchange, with plasmid detection tools benchmarked on short-read data.

ranked.headline: Automated mining of literature and public datasets into queryable network resources
ranked.summary: Public literature, transcriptomic archives and ontology mappings are being converted into queryable network analyses with standardised outputs.

ranked.headline: Computational models resolving peptide modifications in retention and spectral analysis
ranked.summary: Deep learning and spectrum-level methods now model modification chemistry and coexisting PTM isoforms directly from MS data.

ranked.headline: Models tie resistance, biofilm transport, and resource supply to microbial outcomes
ranked.summary: Recent simulation work treats resistance development, time-varying transport, and resource structure as controllable variables within modeling frameworks.

ranked.headline: Foundation and structure-derived models reused for genome, variant, and crystal analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool apply pretrained DNA, vision, and structure-derived models to annotation, variant, and imaging tasks.

ranked.headline: Software implementations of spatial, breeding, and metabolic growth models
ranked.summary: Late-2025 publications and a preprint package established computational methods into open, runnable software for biological modeling and instrumentation.

ranked.headline: Connectivity and geometry models extract disease-relevant variation from neuroimaging
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous multi-site and PET datasets demand explicit models, with diffusion tractography now used as an input to cortical registration.

ranked.headline: Variational and data-driven methods separate neural variability sources in EEG
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study introduce Bayesian and data-driven decompositions of neural variability for M/EEG and single-trial EEG decoding.

ranked.headline: Mechanisms Viral
Mechanism-aware variant classification across single-nucleotide and structural variation
ranked.summary: Rare-disease WGS now resolves complex de novo SVs, while new classifiers separate mechanistic effects of KCNQ1 and mitochondrial disease variants.

ranked.headline: Computational inference of strain and community enzymatic capabilities from genomes
ranked.summary: Machine learning over genome-scale models and metagenome-scale enzyme catalogs now predicts metabolic and catalytic function beyond single reference genomes.

ranked.headline: Open software turns lipidomic, cytokine and multi-omic data into interpretable readouts
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published server extend network-based omics integration into open, accessible tools for interpreting raw measurements.
